svg.title: Caldera: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: A volcano's rim rings the hill: three breaches face the gaps between the teams, so every way in for vehicles is shared with a neighbour. Each team has its own bots-only track over the rim, straight down to a geothermal vent on the caldera floor. The hill is the cone in the middle.
svg.text: Three-way king of the hill · 18 × 18 map (9216 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 3v3v3
A volcano's rim rings the hill: three breaches face the gaps between the teams, so every way in for
vehicles is shared with a neighbour. Each team has its own bots-only track over the rim, straight down to
a geothermal vent on the caldera floor. The hill is the cone in the middle.
Heights: outer flank 180 to 260 · rim 520 · caldera floor 200 · the cone (the hill) 300
Planet Pyre · a volcanic world of basalt and ash
Ground: black basalt and grey ash on the flanks, glowing orange cracks painted across the caldera
floor, obsidian-dark rim cliffs, red cinder roads.
Plants: almost nothing: a few treetype firs on the outermost flank, nothing inside the rim and no
Features: pilha_crystal_obsidian along the rim, pilha_crystal_orange round the vents, agorm_rock
boulders on the flanks, editor_geocrack seams across the floor beside the vents.
Sky and weather: red-brown sky, orange ash fog; wind 0 to 8; tidal 0; wind power is poor here, so
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
